Below are spike counts recorded from 40 neurons in a mouse's primary visual cortex (VISp) while it watched a nature movie. Each trial is a 40x10 matrix: one row per neuron (same neuron order in every matrix), one column per 100 ms time bin (1 s total). There are 4 different movie clips, labeled A, B, C, D; for each clip you get 3 example trials recorded on different viewings of that clip. The query trial is from a new viewing of some clip. It may be one of the clips above, or a clip that is NOT among them. Decide which clip the mouse was watching during the query trial, or say that it matches none of them.
